description: Search and retrieve exhibitor information from Gamescom's official exhibitor database at exhibitors.gamescom.global

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - search: Search for exhibitors with optional filters (query, country, hall, product_sector, initial, page); 参数: query, country, hall, product_sector, initial, search_type, page, page_size; 必填: 无
  - get_exhibitor: Get detailed information about a specific exhibitor by slug; 参数: slug; 必填: slug
  - get_filters: Get available filter options (countries, halls, product sectors, target markets); 参数: 无; 必填: 无

query.description: Search query for exhibitor name, brand, product, or country (used by 'search' function)

country.description: Filter by country/region of origin (used by 'search' function)

hall.description: Filter by hall number (e.g., "Hall 10.1", used by 'search' function)

product_sector.description: Filter by product sector (used by 'search' function)

initial.description: Filter by first letter of company name (A-Z, used by 'search' function)

search_type.description: Search type - "alle" (all words), "any" (any word), "exact" (exact phrase), "title" (only in title) (used by 'search' function)

page.description: Page number for pagination (used by 'search' function)

page_size.description: Number of results per page (used by 'search' function)

slug.description: Exhibitor slug/identifier from search results (used by 'get_exhibitor' function)
